name: Christmas – We Said No Gifts. We Lied.
title: Christmas – We Said No Gifts. We Lied. Mug
story: We said no gifts. We lied: a funny Christmas mug for the couple or family that broke the no-gift pact again. A 1960s husband and wife stand back to back in front of a decorated tree, each hiding a wrapped present behind their back, his in mustard paper with a red ribbon and hers in cream paper with a sage ribbon, and both of them smiling like they got away with it. Every year somebody swears nobody is buying anything, and every year there is a package under the tree with a name on it.

The print is faded red, mustard, sage green and cream with a worn screen-print edge. WE SAID NO GIFTS. runs across the top in bold red slab capitals and WE LIED. runs across the bottom in heavy black capitals, big enough to read across the kitchen table, on bright white glossy ceramic. The same design is printed on both sides, so it faces out in either hand.

It matches our We Said No Gifts tee and the crewneck, so a pair of mugs can sit next to a pair of sweatshirts at the family party. It also works as a small stocking gift, a white elephant pick or one of the christmas gifts for couples who always say they are skipping presents, and it will keep making the same point long after the wrapping paper is gone. Fill it with cocoa, coffee or cider on Christmas morning and wait to see who confesses first.
joke_a: A husband and wife stand back to back, each hiding a wrapped present behind their back, under the confession WE SAID NO GIFTS. WE LIED. The funny Christmas mug from Graphic Tees Co. is for every couple or family that swears off presents and then shows up with one anyway.
